bioParagraphs: I am a creative IT professional from Sammanthurai, Eastern Province, Sri Lanka. I have completed my Higher National Diploma in Information Technology at SLIATE Sammanthurai and I am currently gaining practical experience as a trainee at Brainiacs.

I am passionate about web development, software development, graphic design, and creative digital solutions. I enjoy creating modern websites, attractive digital designs, professional branding materials, and user-friendly digital experiences.
Before completing my HNDIT, I successfully completed the NVQ Level 4 qualification in Information Technology, which provided me with a strong foundation in practical IT systems and technical skills.
I have also completed a Diploma / English Course at the British Council Sri Lanka, which has supported my communication and professional collaboration skills.
I continuously improve my technical and creative abilities and enjoy turning ideas and real-world problems into practical, intuitive and professional digital solutions.

careerGoals.whyIT: I chose Information Technology because I am interested in technology, software development, and creating practical solutions to real-world problems. I enjoy learning new technologies, building applications, solving problems, and continuously improving my technical skills. I believe IT provides opportunities to continuously learn, innovate, and build a meaningful professional career.
careerGoals.currentGoal: My current goal is to strengthen my technical and professional skills through practical experience in software and web development. I want to work on real-world projects, improve my programming knowledge, understand modern development practices, and grow as an IT professional.
careerGoals.futureGoal: My long-term goal is to become a skilled Software Developer and AI-focused technology professional. I want to build innovative and useful software solutions, gain professional industry experience, and continuously develop my knowledge in modern technologies and Artificial Intelligence.
careerGoals.whatMakesMeDifferent: I continuously learn new technologies and enjoy combining software development, creative design and AI tools to create practical digital solutions.
careerGoals.threeToFiveYearGoal: I see myself as a professional Software Developer with strong experience in web development, software systems and Artificial Intelligence, working on real-world projects and building innovative digital solutions.
